CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-thermal-power-option, at head 50af6174f53c0f9bec3f705c3a4bb99615f71acc. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 50af6174f53c0f9bec3f705c3a4bb99615f71acc for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-thermal-power-option, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-thermal-power-option <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-thermal-power-option; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fold (e) of #1955, added by tvofi on 2026-10-04 and left unbuilt when the issue closed. #2006 (merged 2026-10-07) implemented (a)-(d) only: it projects sub-minimum planned levels to p_min, couples the heating flow set-point to the planned level, freezes the house-heat-loss learner without measured power, and refuses a duty-cycle reading that no mechanism can realize. Nothing in the round-10 roster carried (e), which is why the owner's question about it found no open item. What (e) asks for: an OPTIONAL thermal power entity, a config option beside the electrical power and flow entities. When it is configured, three consumers change -- (1) measured COP (thermal divided by electrical) feeds cop_scale learning directly, closing the weather-walking failure flow_lift.py documents, where cop_scale absorbs lift-driven COP drop as degradation on direct plants because compute_cop's flow-temperature term never applies; (2) the house-heat-loss learner takes measured delivered heat as its input instead of the commanded-power assumption or the room-residual fit; (3) the capacity envelope samples at all loads rather than only the >=95%-of-p_max steps it is restricted to today (coordinator.py, the envelope sampler added with the probe). Absent the entity, behaviour is exactly as it is now and the goldens are byte-identical; a fully metered install with the option unset must reproduce today's figures. Use the one install-capability probe (writes available, measured power present, frequency present) that (a), (c) and (d) already read rather than adding a second. The tree already derives thermal output from a flow meter and the supply/return temperatures (flow_meter.thermal_output_kw = flow x 4.186 x dT), but only when no measured power and no frequency signal exist; this option is the direct-sensor case, so say in the body how the two interact and which wins when both are configured.
